name: Tau Ngau
description: Tau Ngau (Bull Fighting) has two main forms. Domino version: 3â€“6 players, banker deals five tiles each; discard three that total a multiple of ten (tiles 4-2 and 2-1 are wild); remaining two tiles give score (mod 10); beat the banker. Card version (Ngau/Gnau): 52-card deck, 2+ players; five cards each; choose three that sum to a multiple of 10 or are three-of-a-kind to be scoring-eligible; two remaining cards give Ox power (face=10, 3s and 6s can be 3 or 6). Hand ranks: Five Dukes, All-Small, Double-Ox, etc. Played in Southeast Asia as casual or gambling game.

rules.objective: Have a higher hand than the banker: after discarding three tiles that total a multiple of 10, the sum of the two remaining tiles (modulo 10) must beat the banker's total.
rules.gameplay:
1. Banker: One player is chosen by dice as banker; sets betting limits and deals.
2. Deal: Banker deals five tiles to each player; players place bets.
3. Discard: Each player chooses three tiles that total a multiple of 10 and discards them; the 4-2 and 2-1 tiles are wild (count as 3 or 6). If a player cannot form a multiple-of-10 discard, they lose their bet; if the banker cannot, the banker pays all who did and others get bets back.
4. Score: Sum the pips on the two remaining tiles and take the last digit (mod 10). Higher than banker wins; lower loses; tie pushes.
5. Bank: If the banker made a discard, the bank passes right; otherwise the banker keeps the bank.
keyRules: Discard exactly three tiles whose pips sum to a multiple of 10; wilds 4-2 and 2-1 may stand for 3 or 6.
Hand score is the sum of the two remaining tiles modulo 10.
Beat the banker's score to win; tie is push.
Banker who cannot discard pays all players who could; players who could not discard get their bets back.

strategy.basic: Identify tiles that can form a multiple of 10; use wilds 4-2 and 2-1 as 3 or 6 when needed.
strategy.intermediate: Split the hand into odd- and even-pip tiles; (even+even+even), (odd+odd+even) can be multiples of 10; (odd+odd+odd) cannot.
strategy.advanced: With five odd tiles you cannot discard and lose; with four odds start from the one even tile; with three odds look for odd+odd+even; with two odds try two odds plus one even, or three evens; with one odd treat it as flexible; with no odds search among all five.
tips: Mental math: only even totals can be multiples of 10.
If you cannot make a discard, you lose your bet; banker in that case pays all who could and returns stakes to those who could not.
